description: EXP-006 [P3 training]: Adam with lr 3e-5 for every trainable parameter in every stage [A] (P3 fine-tunes EfficientNetB1 at 3e-5 with EarlyStopping patience 5). Early stopping is not in the engine; best-checkpoint selection on validation Macro-F1 plays the same role [D]. Stage structure, preprocessing and augmentation identical to EXP-001; weight_decay 0 because P3 reports none.
